clauses.text: This Agreement is entered into between [CLIENT_NAME] ("Client") and [PROVIDER_NAME] ("Service Provider").
This Agreement governs the provision of general repair and maintenance services by the Service Provider to the Client at [PROPERTY_ADDRESS].
The Service Provider shall perform the repair and maintenance tasks described in [REPAIR_TASKS_DESCRIPTION] at [PROPERTY_ADDRESS].

Based on the estimate of [ESTIMATED_COST], the Client shall pay the Service Provider [TOTAL_VALUE] for the Services, payable via [PAYMENT_METHOD] upon completion, unless the Parties agree to a different schedule in writing.
If the Client fails to pay any amount due by its due date, the Service Provider may charge interest on the overdue amount at [LATE_PAYMENT_RATE] per month.
The Services shall begin on [START_DATE] and are expected to be completed by [COMPLETION_DATE].

Unless otherwise agreed, the Service Provider shall supply the materials and parts necessary for the Services, and the cost of materials is included in [TOTAL_VALUE]. Where the Client supplies specific materials or fixtures, the Service Provider is not responsible for defects in those materials.

Where the Service Provider discovers an issue not included in [REPAIR_TASKS_DESCRIPTION] while performing the Services, the Service Provider shall notify the Client and obtain written approval of the additional cost before performing any additional work.
Upon completion, the Service Provider shall remove debris resulting from the Services and leave the work area clean.

The Service Provider warrants the workmanship of the Services for [WARRANTY_PERIOD] from [COMPLETION_DATE]. This warranty excludes damage from misuse, normal wear, and manufacturer defects in materials supplied by the Client.
The Client shall provide the Service Provider with reasonable access to [PROPERTY_ADDRESS], including electricity and water where needed, during agreed working hours.
The Service Provider shall maintain general liability insurance covering its work under this Agreement and shall provide proof of coverage upon the Client's reasonable request.
The Client shall disclose any known hazard or condition affecting the work area, such as faulty wiring, plumbing leaks, or structural issues, before the Services begin.
Neither Party shall be liable to the other for any indirect, incidental, or consequential loss arising from this Agreement.
Each Party's total liability arising from this Agreement shall not exceed [TOTAL_VALUE], except for loss arising from gross negligence, willful misconduct, or fraud.

Neither Party shall be liable for a failure to perform its obligations to the extent that failure results from an event beyond that Party's reasonable control that could not have been avoided through reasonable diligence. The affected Party shall notify the other Party without undue delay.
This Agreement shall be governed by [APPLICABLE_LAW]. Any dispute shall be submitted to [DISPUTE_RESOLUTION_MECHANISM] before litigation, except where interim injunctive relief is required.
The Parties have executed this Agreement as of [SIGNATURE_DATE].
